title: Entrance parking stripe correction from visible aerial bay boundaries
coordinate_space: Top-left pixels of the 3000 x 2500 county aerial used by site-layout.json

source_aerial.rights: Research comparison only; not used as a scene texture or redistributed with geometry.

cross_check.observation: Visible shorter paired bays, central divide and hatched rounded end areas; capture date may differ from 2026 aerial.

diagnosis.problem: Overlong single-bay depth overlaps opposing rows; generic count rhythm adds one division per row and omits central/end paint. Conversion formula is correct; coarse source depth/count interpretation is not consistent with visible entrance boundaries.

uncertainty_note: Manual boundary/corner reading, some paint obscured by cars and shadows; approximately 0.44 m from pixel annotation alone. Source georegistration, terrain and temporal differences are additional. Rendered bay count is not official site capacity.
scope: Correct entry_outer_row_1 through entry_outer_row_4 paint and observed hatched ends; clip the ten separate inferred access-aisle hatches outside the existing Entry concrete apron footprint and conform retained paint to the actual rendered asphalt. No cars, curbs, accessible symbols, drainage or other parking rows change.
paint_notes: Existing faded parking material reused. Line width, corner rounding, evenly spaced interpolation and hatch rhythm are restrained approximations of worn visible paint; no compliance claim.

access_aisle_clipping.source: Ten builder curves named Accessible access aisle hatch at constant z=0.05
access_aisle_clipping.diagnosis: Their XY segments cross the existing Entry concrete apron. Paint for an inferred parking aisle should stop at its curb.
access_aisle_clipping.method: Read actual apron footprint; split source segments at its edges; retain outside intervals with 0.08 m curb clearance. Final paint heights conform to rendered asphalt plus the recorded small clearance; the bilinear terrain is only an initial scaffold.
access_aisle_clipping.evidence_status: Construction correction using existing modeled apron, not a newly measured accessible-parking layout. Original builder inputs are retained unchanged.

paint_surface_note: Final paint uses downward raycasts onto actual evaluated asphalt faces plus 0.012 m rendering clearance. The older ground+.04 field is retained only as the initial scaffold/history. Adaptive XY triangulation preserves painted coverage while checking edge and face samples. This small separation prevents mesh occlusion and does not claim physical paint thickness.
